scope: Write one bounded authored POINTCLOUDEX object graph through the concrete adapter with rooted DefinitionEx records, reciprocal ReactorEx records, output identity remapping, and fresh typed readback.

behavior: Authored data only (dx_source_format::Unknown) is admitted. Imported DXF still needs a raw-carrier/source-span join; DWG still needs source CLASS/frame/output binding.
AC1027+ output requires exactly one NOD ACAD_POINTCLOUD_EX_DICT edge to a complete NOD-owned DICTIONARY. Every dictionary entry must uniquely own one POINTCLOUDDEFINITIONEX.

Every admitted DefinitionEx has a complete reactor list. Each ReactorEx has one owning POINTCLOUDEX entity; entity definition/reactor references, reactor owner, and DefinitionEx persistent-reactor list must agree exactly.

Definitions and reactors emit through the typed low-level writer after reserving and collision-remapping their identities. The named dictionary is emitted through the codec's named-object path, and the entity references use the same handle remap.
Classic POINTCLOUD definitions/reactors, NAVISWORKSMODELDEF, POINTCLOUDCOLORMAP, imported source records, incomplete graphs, and lower target revisions remain refused.

validationProfile.source: Locally authored in-memory records and handles; no external file and no drawing fixture.
assertions: The exact NOD-to-dictionary-to-DefinitionEx path and one POINTCLOUDEX-to-ReactorEx owner/reference cycle are serialized and read back.
Readback checks the named dictionary entry and one-instance POINTCLOUDDEFINITIONEX/POINTCLOUDDEFREACTOREX CLASS rows.
A wrong ReactorEx owner is refused before publication and preserves existing destination bytes.
Correcting the same adapter graph permits retry; readback confirms the reactor owner follows the emitted entity handle, including its remap, while definition and reference handles remain reciprocal.
Existing controls still refuse an unrooted mixed definition/NAVISWORKS/color-map graph and POINTCLOUDEX below its writer revision floor.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; ASCII/Binary graph admission, invalid-owner destination preservation, same-adapter corrected retry, and typed graph readback.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: This proves authored serializer transport and graph closure only; it does not establish physical producer breadth or independent source-to-output equivalence.
DWG-origin callbacks remain refused until exact source CLASS/frame identities and all output bindings are qualified.
Point-cloud assets are not loaded or independently interpreted. Native FreeCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, and 3D consumer semantics remain unqualified.
observations: Initial readback assertion expected the reactor owner to retain the entity's source handle. Actual output correctly remapped the entity and emitted the reactor owner to that output handle; the assertion now checks the emitted identity.
next: Bind imported DXF point-cloud records to complete ordered raw carriers and physical source spans before admitting DXF-origin graph output. Then qualify a DWG source CLASS/frame profile and output binding; keep native asset loading and semantic consumer evidence separate.
